title: 第19章 五年第20章 文种
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
正闹着，忽听得背后马蹄杂沓，火光冲天。那楚国追兵已如潮水般涌到近前。
为首的军官勒住战马，手中长戈一指，狞笑道：“跑啊！怎的不跑了？前有大江，后有大军，今日你们插翅也难飞出这天罗地网！乖乖受缚罢！”
范蠡吓得一骨碌爬起身，顾不得屁股疼，死死抱住陶潜的胳膊，哆嗦道：“老……老师！这可如何是好？真要成肉泥了！”
陶潜停了手，将那桃木拐杖往地上一杵，仰面哈哈大笑：“区区凡夫俗子，也敢说留住老道？”
说罢，老道大喝一声：“起！”
但见他大袖一挥，平地里猛地刮起一阵狂风。
好大风！真个是：飞沙走石乾坤暗，播土扬尘日月昏！那风呼啸着卷起一团清气，将陶潜、范蠡与那伍子胥一并裹在其中。
楚国甲士被吹得人仰马翻，连眼睛都睁不开。待风头过后定睛一看，江边空空荡荡，哪里还有半个人影？
那一阵怪风托着三人，直如腾云驾雾一般，须臾间便横渡了八百里茫茫大江。
“扑通”几声，三人稳稳落在对岸沙滩上。范蠡晕头转向地跌坐在地，摸了摸项上人头，大口喘着粗气：“我的个亲娘哎，小命可算保住了！”
那伍子胥此刻方才如梦初醒，深知遇上了真仙。
当即推金山、倒玉柱，纳头便拜：“老神仙！伍员肉眼凡胎，不知真仙降临，多有冒犯，万望恕罪！多谢老神仙救命之恩！”
陶潜摆了摆手：“不是神仙，鬼仙罢了，你且起来罢。”
伍子胥直起身，眼中满是凄切与期盼，拱手问道：“老仙既有通天彻地之能，敢问伍员此去吴国，借兵讨楚，这血海深仇可能报得？”
陶潜深深看了他一眼，叹道：“仇自是能报，只是天机难测，老道赠你一言，你以吴兴，必以吴亡。”
伍子胥听罢，心头一震，正欲细问其中玄机，却见陶潜一把揪起地上的范蠡，大袖飘飘，转身便走。
“哎哎哎！老师，轻点揪！领子勒脖子了！”范蠡手舞足蹈地叫唤着。
“老仙……”伍子胥刚唤出声，但见那林中清风一拂，一老一少的身影便如泡影般融入夜色，须臾间消失在幽暗的树林之中，再无踪迹。
只余下江风猎猎，浊浪滔滔。
次日天明，金鸡报晓。但见那荒山野岭之中，一个少年正挥舞着一把豁口的破斧头，“吭哧吭哧”地照着一棵大老粗的松树卖死力气。

这少年不是别人，正是那惹了祸的范蠡。
再看那不远处的一块光溜溜的大青石上，好个老道！陶潜四仰八叉地躺着，脸上盖着两片大树叶遮挡日头，翘着个二郎腿，悠哉游哉地晃荡着。
“小瘪犊子，快着些砍！”陶潜连树叶都不揭，扯着嗓子骂道，“日落前若是搭不出个遮风避雨的木屋，你就别想吃饭了！谁让你个混小子多管闲事，惹下那等泼天大祸，害得老道连个客栈的安稳觉都睡不成？”
范蠡抹了一把额头上的汗珠，只觉得两臂酸麻，虎口震得生疼，忍不住唉声叹气，只得咬紧牙关，抡起斧头继续“邦邦”地砍树。
光阴似箭，日月如梭，眨眼间便过了数日。
这几日里，范蠡白天苦哈哈地伐木搭棚，累得像条死狗。
陶潜却是落得个清闲，终日盘膝打坐，吞吐天地灵气，修持金丹大道，又练习七十二变以及法天象地，几日的修持，以让他将两门法术修炼小成。
闲来无事时，又指点范蠡一门风法，再传授些奇门遁甲、阴阳五行的杂学，只是范蠡不愿意学那些知识，认为既不能安邦定国，又不能富国强兵，心里便老大个不愿意。
这小子每每听讲，总是左耳朵进右耳朵出，暗自腹诽道：“这等杂学既不能治国，也不能平天下，学来作甚？”
他满脸的不情愿，消极怠工，气得陶潜时常举起那根油光水滑的桃木拐杖，追着他满山乱跑，又是一顿好揍。
唯一让陶潜感到满意的就是对方修炼法术的天资不错，一个星期就将他的三真风法入门了，为此陶潜得到了一个不大不小的法术，腾云驾雾，但是感觉没有什么用，因为他用风法也能御风而行。
这一日，陶潜将那油光水滑的桃木拐杖往青石上重重一顿，喝道：“小瘪犊子，滚过来！你不是成日里嫌老道教你道理不中用，不能安邦定国么？今日老道便传你个真本事，学了去，莫说富国强兵，便是叫一个将亡之国起死回生，也是易如反掌！”
范蠡闻言，眼中精光大盛，哪里还有半点惫懒模样？当即丢了手中破斧，扑通一声跪倒在地，磕头如捣蒜：“老师快讲！弟子洗耳恭听，绝不敢再左耳朵进右耳朵出！”
陶潜盘膝坐定，便将那天地阴阳消长、万物盛衰循环、丰歉交替的周期之理娓娓道来。
言言见道，字字玄机。范蠡本是个心如明镜的奇才，于这等治世经邦的学问真是一点就透，听得如痴如醉。
光阴似箭，日月如梭。山中无甲子，寒尽不知年。转眼间，便过了五个寒暑。
这五年里，范蠡不仅将那天道周期之理烂熟于心，更将那“三真风法”练得炉火纯青。
他仗着这门法术，时不时便捏个风诀，化作一阵清风，去那三山五岳、大江南北游荡一番，真个是快活。
这一日，范蠡忽地按落风头，稳稳落在陶潜跟前，整了整衣冠，郑重深施一礼道：“老师，弟子离家五载，欲回楚地探望兄长。二来，弟子胸中已藏韬略，正要入世寻个明主，验证老师所授的天道周期之理，好生施展一番抱负！”
陶潜正躺在青石上晒太阳，闻言剔了剔牙，眼皮也不抬地摆摆手：“去罢去罢，天高任鸟飞，莫在这儿搅扰老道清修。”

范蠡却不挪步，两只眼睛滴溜溜直转，涎着脸凑上前，搓着手道：“老师，临行之前，弟子还有个不情之请。五年前那老人您的那卷《捭阖》竹简，您老人家当个命根子似的捂着，防贼一样防着弟子。今日弟子下山，您老就发发慈悲，借弟子开开眼罢！”
虽然陶潜教了他很多，但范蠡最好奇的还是陶潜手中那门竹简，直觉告诉他里面的东西肯定比陶潜教它更厉害的知识。
只是老头不肯给他看，不管他怎么求爷爷告奶奶老头死活都不肯。

content_en:
While they were making a fuss, they suddenly heard the clatter of horse hooves behind them and the sound of fire shooting into the sky. The Chu soldiers were already approaching like a tide.
The leading officer reined in his horse, pointed the long sword in his hand, and said with a ferocious smile: "Run! Why don't you run? There is a big river in front of you, and a big army behind you. It's hard for you to fly out of this dragnet even if you have wings today! Just be bound!"
Fan Li was so frightened that he jumped up. Regardless of the pain in his butt, he hugged Tao Qian's arm tightly and trembled: "Old...teacher! What should I do? I'm really going to turn into a pulp!"
Tao Qian stopped, slammed the mahogany crutch on the ground, and laughed loudly: "How dare you, a mere mortal, say that you should keep an old Taoist?"
After saying that, the old Taoist shouted: "Get up!"
But when he waved his sleeves, a strong wind suddenly blew from the plains.
It's so windy! The real thing is: flying sand and moving stones, the world is dark, sowing dust and dust, the sun and the moon are dim! The wind howled and rolled up a cloud of fresh air, wrapping Tao Qian, Fan Li and Wu Zixu together in it.
The Chu soldiers were so blown away that they couldn't even open their eyes. After the storm passed, I took a closer look and saw that the riverside was empty. There was not even half a human figure anywhere.
The strange wind carried the three of them like soaring clouds and mist, and they crossed the 800-mile vast river in an instant.
After a few "plops", the three of them landed firmly on the beach on the other side. Fan Li fell to the ground dizzy, touched the head on his neck, and gasped: "My dear mother, your life is saved!"
Wu Zixu had just woken up from a dream and knew that he had met a true immortal.
He immediately pushed the golden mountain, toppled the jade pillar, bowed his head and said, "Old Immortal! The members of our team were born with naked eyes and did not know that the real immortal was coming. I have offended you so much. I hope I will forgive you! Thank you Old Immortal for saving your life!"
Tao Qian waved his hand: "It's not a god, it's just a ghost. Just get up."
Wu Zixu straightened up, his eyes full of sorrow and expectation, and raised his hands and asked: "Since the old immortal has the power to reach the heaven and the earth, do you dare to ask if our members will be able to avenge this bloody feud if they go to the Kingdom of Wu and borrow troops to attack Chu?"
Tao Qian took a deep look at him and sighed: "I can avenge myself, but the fate is unpredictable. I will give you a word from the old Taoist. If you use Wu to prosper, you will definitely use Wu to perish."
After hearing this, Wu Zixu was shocked. Just as he was about to ask more about the mystery, he saw Tao Qian grabbing Fan Li from the ground, his sleeves fluttering, and turned around to leave.
"Hey, hey, hey! Teacher, pull gently! The collar is strangling my neck!" Fan Li shouted dancing.
"Old Immortal..." Wu Zixu just called out, but as soon as the breeze blew in the forest, the figures of the old man and the young man melted into the night like bubbles, and disappeared into the dark woods in an instant, without a trace anymore.
Only the river wind is left, and the turbid waves are roaring.
At dawn the next day, the golden rooster crows. But in the barren mountains and ridges, a young man was wielding a broken axe, "crack-crack-clop-crack", working hard against a big and thick pine tree.
This young man was none other than Fan Li, who had caused trouble.
Look at the big smooth bluestone not far away, what an old man! Tao Qian was lying on his back, his face covered with two large leaves to block the sun, his legs crossed, and he was swinging leisurely.
"You little brat, chop it down quickly!" Tao Qian didn't even lift the leaves and cursed at the top of his voice, "If you can't build a wooden house to shelter from the wind and rain before sunset, you won't be able to eat! Who told you, a bastard, to meddle in your own business and cause such a big disaster that the old man can't even sleep peacefully in an inn?"
Fan Li wiped the sweat from his forehead. He felt his arms were sore and numb, and the tiger's mouth was so painful that he couldn't help but sigh. He had to grit his teeth, pick up the ax and continue to chop down the tree.
Time flies like an arrow, the sun and the moon fly by, and a few days pass in the blink of an eye.
In the past few days, Fan Li had been working hard cutting trees and building sheds during the day, and was as tired as a dead dog.
Tao Qian, however, had a lot of leisure, sitting cross-legged and meditating all day long, breathing in the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, cultivating the golden elixir avenue, and practicing the seventy-two changes and the law of heaven, elephant and earth. After several days of practice, he could master the two spells in a small way.become.
When he had nothing to do, he taught Fan Li a style of art and taught him some miscellaneous knowledge about Qimen Dunjia, Yin Yang and Five Elements. However, Fan Li was unwilling to learn that knowledge, thinking that he could neither stabilize the country nor enrich the country and strengthen the army, so he felt unwilling to do so.
Whenever this kid listens to lectures, he always hears something go in one ear and out the other, secretly cursing: "This kind of miscellaneous knowledge can neither govern the country nor bring peace to the world, so what are you doing with it?"
His face was full of reluctance and passiveness in his work, which made Tao Qian so angry that he would often pick up the smooth peach wood cane and chase him all over the mountain, giving him another good beating.
The only thing that satisfied Tao Qian was that the other party had good talent in practicing magic. He had mastered his Three True Wind Techniques in a week. For this reason, Tao Qian got a medium-sized spell, soaring into the clouds and driving the mist, but he felt that it was of no use because he could also use the wind method to control the wind.
On this day, Tao Qian slammed his oily peach wood crutch onto the bluestone and shouted: "You little kid, get over here! Don't you always think that the old Taoist teachings to you are useless and cannot stabilize the country? Today the old Taoist will teach you his true skills. Learn from it. Not to mention enriching the country and strengthening the army, it is easy to bring a dying country back to life!"
When Fan Li heard this, his eyes shone brightly, but he still looked a little bit lazy. Immediately he threw away the broken ax in his hand, fell to his knees with a thump, and kowtowed as if pounding garlic: "Teacher, please speak quickly! I am all ears, and I will never dare to go in with one ear and out with the other!"
Tao Qian sat cross-legged and explained the principles of the cycle of growth and decline of yin and yang in heaven and earth, the cycle of rise and fall of all things, and the alternation of abundance and decline.
Every word reveals the truth, and every word is mysterious. Fan Li was originally a genius with a clear mind, and he was very familiar with the knowledge of governing the world, and he was fascinated by it.
Time flies like an arrow, and the sun and moon fly like a shuttle. There are no Jiazi in the mountains, and it is so cold that I don’t know the year. In the blink of an eye, five winters and summers passed.
In the past five years, Fan Li has not only mastered the principles of the cycle of Heaven's Dao, but also practiced the "Three True Wind Techniques" to perfection.
Relying on this magic, he would make a wind trick from time to time, turning it into a breeze, and wandering around the three mountains, five mountains, and the north and south of the river. It was really happy.
On this day, Fan Li suddenly stepped down from the limelight and landed firmly in front of Tao Qian. He adjusted his clothes and bowed solemnly and said: "Teacher, I have been away from home for five years and want to return to the Chu land to visit my brother. Secondly, I have a strategy in mind and am about to enter the world to find an enlightened master to verify the principles of the cycle of heaven taught by my teacher so that I can express my ambition!"
Tao Qian was lying on the bluestone basking in the sun. After hearing this, he picked his teeth and waved his hands without raising his eyelids: "Just go and let the birds fly. Don't disturb the old Taoist Qingxiu here."
Fan Li did not move, his eyes were rolling, he came forward with a salivating face, rubbed his hands and said: "Teacher, before I leave, I have one more unkind request. The bamboo slips of "Mao He" that the old man wrote five years ago, you are holding on to them as if they are lifeblood, guarding them like thieves. Today, when my disciples come down the mountain, you always show mercy and let me open my eyes!"
Although Tao Qian taught him a lot, Fan Li was most curious about the bamboo slips in Tao Qian's hands. His intuition told him that the things inside must be more powerful knowledge than what Tao Qian had taught him.
It's just that the old man refused to show it to him. No matter how he begged his grandfather to sue his grandmother, the old man refused.
